lines.t: Yeah, no auto-tune, no fake crowns, truth talk only
Came from the dirt where the wolves all grin
Fake throne stack but the soul stay thin
They flex for the net, I bow to the throne
You chase the bag, I walk alone, never loud with it, never flashy speech
Truth moves silent till it gotta preach, steel in the spine
Peace in the eyes, don't need a crowd when the call come down from the sky
I don't move till he say move, I don't speak till he say speak
Low walk, head bow, but the word hit hard when it breach
Man of God, no disguise
No lies
Seen kings fold for a moment of fame
Sell their soul just to light their name
I'd rather wait in the shadows alone
Than rush ahead where he ain't shown
Not my will, not my plan
I don't run unless sent by his hand
Quiet steps but the ground still shake
When heaven speak, decisions break
Patience louder than a loaded gun
Obedience heavier than what I've done
You want power, learn how to wait You want truth, learn how to obey
No religion, no clout chase Commandments live, not a cost to face
World too loud, spirit too numb But the cost ain't clear when the kingdom come
Don't ask why I ain't in the mix I don't drink poison just to feel legit
Set apart, cut different Chosen don't blend, they walk submitted
A man of God is humble and quiet until called upon to speak.
A man of low degree who treads softly until called upon to act.
A lowly man who is completely in love with me, who does not his own will nor seek his own way.
A man who waits upon the Lord
And hesitates not when the command
Comes down from the mouth of the Lord is God
A man after my own heart
My servant, my friend
Says the Lord
We'll be right back.
